management.archiveDescription: Stops scheduling and execution. Rules, runs, data and delivery history are retained.
management.restoreDescription: Scheduling remains disabled after restoration. Review the rule and policy before enabling it.
management.deleteDescription: Source deletion cannot be undone. Rules, runs, data, AI tasks and other historical records are retained.
management.deleteImpact: Removes the source from lists and its requirement, and releases the URL. Adding the same URL creates an independent source.
management.deleteSchedule: The enabled schedule will be turned off.
management.deleteHistory: Existing evidence and attribution remain unchanged. History is marked Source deleted. Existing deliveries continue as scheduled; deletion does not resend or cancel them.
management.deleteBlocked: Stop or wait for active work, or finish or abandon the field migration, then reload the preview.
management.deletedNotice: This source cannot be restored. Historical records and evidence remain available.
management.reassignDescription: History stays attributed to its original requirement. Future collection uses the target's published field contract.
management.noTargets: No other active requirements are available.
management.recompile: Disables scheduling and clears the candidate, active rule and checkpoint. Exploration, review and publication are required. Historical rules, runs, data and deliveries stay unchanged; Webhook settings are retained.
management.emptyMove: Binds the empty source to the target requirement and adopts its intent. Exploration, review and publication are required.
management.archivedNotice: This source is archived. Scheduling and execution are disabled; historical records remain available.
